# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Stronger hash code seed generation**

## Highlights

Upcoming SkiaSharp changes strengthen hash-code seeding while preserving within-process hash stability.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hash seeds use operating-system randomness** — The HashCode polyfill compiled into SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now uses RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random for its per-process seed. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes. First use now loads cryptography support and adds initialization overhead. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
